<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>Infogames.com - Relojería RetroGamer </title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <style>
    :root{font-family: 'Lucida Console', Monaco, monospace;color:#0ff;}
    *{box-sizing:border-box;}
    body{margin:0;line-height:1.5;background:#000;background-image:radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(0,255,255,.3), transparent 20%), radial-gradient(circle at bottom right, rgba(255,0,255,.25), transparent 24%);color:#0ff;text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,255,255,.5);}
    body::before{content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,255,255,.1),transparent 30%,rgba(255,0,255,.1));pointer-events:none;}
    header{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:24px 0;border-bottom:3px solid #0ff;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(0,255,255,.6),inset 0 0 20px rgba(0,255,255,.1);}
    header::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%, rgba(0,255,255,.3), transparent 18%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(255,0,255,.25), transparent 18%);pointer-events:none;}
    .container{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 18px;position:relative;}
    .header-brand{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;}
    .brand-mark{width:68px;height:68px;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff00ff,#00ffff);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:2rem;box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(255,0,255,.8),0 0 60px rgba(0,255,255,.6);border:2px solid #0ff;animation:pulse 2s infinite;}
    @keyframes pulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(255,0,255,.8),0 0 60px rgba(0,255,255,.6);}50%{box-shadow:0 0 50px rgba(255,0,255,.8),0 0 80px rgba(0,255,255,.6);}}
    .brand-copy{min-width:220px;}
    .site-title{font-size:2rem;line-height:1.1;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.18em;margin:0;color:#0ff;text-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(0,255,255,.8),0 0 40px rgba(255,0,255,.6);}
    .site-tagline{margin:.4rem 0 0;color:#0ff;font-size:.92rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,255,255,.5);}
    nav.top{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:16px;}
    nav.top a{color:#0ff;text-decoration:none;padding:10px 16px;border:2px solid #0ff;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(0,255,255,.05);transition:.2s;text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,255,255,.7);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,255,255,.3);}
    nav.top a:hover{background:rgba(0,255,255,.2);box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(0,255,255,.8),inset 0 0 10px rgba(0,255,255,.3);text-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(0,255,255,.9);}
    .hero{background:rgba(0,20,30,.8);border:2px solid #0ff;border-radius:24px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(0,255,255,.5),inset 0 0 20px rgba(0,255,255,.1);margin:24px 0;}
    .hero h2{color:#0ff;text-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(0,255,255,.8);}
    .hero p{max-width:760px;color:#0ff;text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,255,255,.5);}
    main{padding:24px 0;}
    .card{background:rgba(0,20,30,.9);padding:22px;margin:18px 0;border-radius:18px;border:2px solid #0ff;box-shadow:0 0 25px rgba(0,255,255,.5),inset 0 0 15px rgba(0,255,255,.08);}
    .card h1,.card h2{color:#0ff;margin-top:0;text-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(0,255,255,.8);}
    .grid-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:18px;margin-top:18px;}
    .product-card{background:rgba(0,30,40,.8);padding:18px;border-radius:18px;border:2px solid #0ff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(0,255,255,.4);transition:.3s;}
    .product-card:hover{box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(0,255,255,.8),0 0 60px rgba(255,0,255,.5);border-color:#ff00ff;transform:translateY(-5px);}
    .product-card img{width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:14px;border:2px solid #0ff;box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(0,255,255,.5);}
    .product-card h3{margin:0;font-size:1.15rem;color:#0ff;text-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(0,255,255,.7);}
    .product-card p{margin:0;color:#0ff;flex:1;text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(0,255,255,.4);}
    .product-card a{color:#0ff;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,255,255,.6);}
    .product-card a:hover{color:#ff00ff;text-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,0,255,.8);text-decoration:underline;}
    .content-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px;align-items:start;}
    .media{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
    .media img{width:320px;height:auto;border-radius:14px;border:2px solid #0ff;box-shadow:0 0 25px rgba(0,255,255,.5);}
    .lead{font-weight:700;color:#0ff;text-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(0,255,255,.7);}
    .footer-inner{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;align-items:center;}
    footer{background:rgba(0,0,0,.95);border-top:3px solid #0ff;padding:20px 0;margin-top:32px;box-shadow:0 0 25px rgba(0,255,255,.4);}
    footer p{margin:0;color:#0ff;font-size:.95rem;text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,255,255,.6);}
    img.responsive{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:14px;border:2px solid #0ff;box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(0,255,255,.5);}
    .store-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(0,255,255,.15);color:#0ff;font-size:.9rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;margin-top:12px;border:2px solid #0ff;box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(0,255,255,.5);text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,255,255,.7);}
    @media(max-width:900px){.content-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.container{padding:0 14px;}.site-title{font-size:1.6rem;}.hero{margin:18px 0;}}
  </style>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles/neon.css">
</head>

            <h3><a href="call-of-duty.html">Call of Duty</a></h3>
            <p>Call of Duty es un shooter en primera persona ambientado en la Segunda Guerra Mundial. Lanzado en 2003 para PC, publicado por Activision y desarrollado por Infinity Ward.</p>

            <a href="call-of-duty-movil.html"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Call of Duty Móvil"></a>

            <p>CALL OF DUTY®: MOBILE es la versión oficial para móviles con modos multijugador, Battle Royale 100 jugadores, zombis y armamento personalizable.</p>
          </article>
          <article class="product-card">
            <a href="fortnite.html"><img src="https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fortnite/images/5/53/Battle_Royale_-_Playlist_-_Fortnite.jpg/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/200?cb=20240524210440" alt="Fortnite"></a>
            <h3><a href="fortnite.html">Fortnite</a></h3>
            <p>Fortnite es un juego multijugador masivo en línea de Epic Games, disponible en PC, consolas y móviles con modos como Battle Royale, Creativo y más.</p>

          </article>

            <h3><a href="minecraft.html">Minecraft</a></h3>
            <p>Minecraft es un juego de construcción y supervivencia basado en bloques, disponible en casi todas las plataformas y con modos creativo y supervivencia.</p>
          </article>
          <article class="product-card">
            <a href="the-forest.html"><img src="https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQKMzoJBn6Q3KbE2mh44EXsBhkaM0KBSXjZp7ErJHS-&s" alt="The Forest"></a>
